name: ShroudForge No Stamina Loss
description: Keeps the local player's typed stamina runtime components from depleting.

changelog: Added a declarative overview page for the Modloader UI.
Added separate depletion prevention and automatic refill controls.

settingGroups.label: Stamina behavior
settingGroups.description: Configure the two typed stamina operations independently.

settings.label: Prevent stamina depletion
settings.description: Clears accumulated stamina depletion during gameplay.

settings.label: Refill stamina to maximum
settings.description: Restores current stamina to the typed maximum value.

components.label: Local client runtime
components.text: The mod applies the selected stamina operations during gameplay.
Depletion prevention and automatic refill can be configured independently.
